training.method: JEPA-style context-to-target EMA latent prediction with context variance regularization

training.timing_note: Wall time includes batching, optimizer, device synchronization; total additionally includes validation, CPU covariance diagnostics, and final validation target-shuffle diagnostic. Not a hardware benchmark.
training.collapse_heuristic: mean coordinate std < 0.01 OR covariance effective rank < 2; heuristic only

validation_pairing_diagnostic.interpretation: Higher shuffled loss is heuristic evidence of context-target correspondence. A single shuffle is not a significance test, an independent utility result, or proof against collapse.
